But this B.O.B bar kinda blew my mind. The first time I used this bar, my hair was very very dirty with excise sweat and DAYS of dry shampoo buildup. I’m not saying it smells like Le Labo but the scent is in the same herbal/woody family. I really don’t care for flowery or fruity scents and this is the only bar I’ve found so far that ticks all the boxes. It lathers well and gently cleanses my hair leaving it feeling clean but not stripped. After the first use I could tell a difference in the softness of my h

I was skeptical of this actually working when I bout it but now I love it, it smells great and works wonderfully! I have a child with sensory issues and she dreads washing her because of the feel of shampoo and conditioner... this changed her mind on shampoo and conditioner, she absolutely loves this when she realized shampoo and conditioner came in a bar, she was overjoyed and ready to use it... she loves it I love it and now I'm going to buy more!!!

My first impressions were very positive - the ingredients looked clean and natural, as well as being cruelty-free and vegan, I love that it’s plastic free (both the lack of bottle and the packaging), and that the scent options were relatively gender neutral. So I purchased this for an international flight from Pennsylvania to Peru because I was running out of room in my liquids bag. I thought this would be a good alternative and I typically use an expensive purifying salon brand shampoo so after reading a bunch of reviews for various bars decided to purchase this. reviews.t: The only one that's worked for me!
reviews.x: This is the 3rd shampoo bar I've tried on my curly & colored hair.  The first 2 left a waxy film on my hair that only came off with a conditioner, so I was not going to try another shampoo bar.  But I gave in and bought BOB and am I glad I did.  I purchased it with the companion conditioner.  No waxy film, it rinsed out clean and my hair felt good.  The conditioner bar also left my hair easy to comb out and manageable.  The scents are mild, which I like.  Great eco-free packaging.  I am a happy

reviews.t: Drying if you use too much
reviews.x: This seems to be very drying to my hair and so I decided I'm using too much. I tried just lathering it in my hands, instead of rubbing the bar on my head,  and putting in on the roots and lightly scrubbing and then pulling it through when I  rinse. It's  surprising how much it lathers up in my hair! This keeps the ends from drying out but gives me volume at the roots. I'm  liking this more and more.
I bought this with the matching conditioner bar and my hair has NEVER been so beautiful. Plus, it's so compact and lasts a really long time! I will buy this for life!

reviews.t: Never going back to bottled hair care!
reviews.x: I ordered a few of these shampoo and conditioner bars to try and I love them. My hair feels and looks so soft and clean. I've been using these for over a month and there is still half a bar left (one shampoo and one conditioner). Thanks for a sustainable healthy product that really works and that I can feel good about using.  Edit: 2 Shampoo bars and 2 conditioner bars have now lasted me over 6 months and I still have about 2 months or so left before the product runs out. How amazing that these

Love the idea of no bottles.  Can't recycle them anymore but boxes are still recyclable. But to me the product is the key.  I have naturally gray hair but oily, go figure.  Guess I'm lucky but hard to find shampoo that doesn't weigh my hair down and look dirty.  BOB is perfect for me.  Thanx BOB.

reviews.t: Best shampoo bar for curly hair!
reviews.x: The best shampoo bar I have ever used! I switched to shampoo bars about 4 years ago and have tried many different brands and types. A lot of shampoo bars I've tried either leave my hair feeling either dry or super oily. This moisturizing shampoo bar is perfect. My hair feels clean, moisturized, less frizzy and my curls are defined - without the use of any other products, wow! (For my other curly girls out there, I'm a 2c curl type). I always look for products that are non-toxic, planet-friendly,

This is my third bar of shampoo from this company and I havent been disappointed so far. The product isnt too large but it lasts so long for me and my two daughters that I do believe it is worth the price point. The oz weight is listed in the product description if anyone is interested. The only thing that my one daughter and I didnt care for on this particular bar was the scent. It was a little too flowery and powdery for us. It doesn't bother you once you have used it and rinsed but during app

reviews.t: Moisturizing bar is AMAZING, Detox scent is overwhelming
reviews.x: I have tried three of the shampoo bars and one of the conditioner bars from this company. The performance of the Moisturizing shampoo bar is perfect for curly hair, and I absolutely love the scent. It wears out much faster than the matching conditioner, though--I would estimate one conditioner bar for every three shampoo bars.  The Intense conditioner is very nice, but it leaves a little residue, so I tried both the Purifying and Detox bars to reset my hair every few shampoos. The Purifying is r

So the only reason I take off a star....is I have been using the bars in the wrong order. I bought bother the shampoo and conditioner. Went to use them, and both have a color coded sticker to make sure you are using the right bar. So when the shampoo didn't suds but the conditioner did I immediately picked the boxes out of the trash to confirm.  According to the packages I was using the correct bars in the correct order. So this has been a few weeks of me conditioning and shampooing in that orde

reviews.t: Put the bar on your head! And reduce your carbon footprint ;)
reviews.x: If you want this to lather, don't lather it in your hands, put the bar on your head to get it to lather. Also, your hair needs to be very wet. Then you will have cRazY lather, and it smells SO GOOD! I ordered patchouli and lavender--smells like essential oils. I have pretty dry hair, and I do use a conditioner after, which I would do anyway. If I do not use conditioner, my hair feels the same as if I used any other shampoo, not any drier or any more moisturized.  And it feels great to be getting

I have a decent amount of hair, but it’s baby fine and very oily.  I love this bar!  My hair never feels greasy by the end of the day. As with all shampoos, I do a quick wash with a small amount to break up the oil, rinse, reapply with a little bit more and let it sit while I wash.  Then I condition my ends and comb through. The smell isn’t anything fancy, but I’m good with that.  Love this for travel.  Love it now for home, while saving plastic.  I keep it in a draining dish.

Not used to bar shampoos yet. First try at any product. Not totally impressed yet. I’m not sure if it’s actually better for my hair than other plastic bottle shampoos I’ve been using this whole time. And no….it doesn’t take two swipes of the bar across my thick hair to get it lathering. I have to let water run over it and rub round my hair several times to get lathered. Smell is just OKAY, not my favorite. Resembles lemon balm too closely for my scent/taste.

I got this patchouli/lavender bar in hopes to help restore my good hair after a stylist overbleached / botched it. First use: great lather, super cleansing, smells great, easy to comb through, air dried and voila, amazing shine, softness, just from this one bar! I'm a forever believer/customer from here on!

reviews.t: Best shampoo bar so far for my fine, oily hair!
reviews.x: Within the last year I have made the switch to shampoo bars.  This bar is the best one that I have used.  I have very fine, thin, oily hair.  With this bar and the help of some dry shampoo  I don't need to wash my hair everyday.  My hair feels so soft and manageable  after using this bar.

Love this shampoo bar. It clarifies and even seems to moisturize a bit. No extra conditioner needed, just added some oils to my ends after showering. Love that I'm able to find a good product and ditch the plastic bottles!
I usually use bed head shampoo and conditioner and it would leave my curls frizzy and bushy this shampoo with the conditioner left me with refined curls I’m very happy with the results
Love what this has done for my hair. Switched from head and shoulders to the extra moisturizing shampoo and conditioner bars and wow!

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the product for working well on curly and textured hair, leaving curls light, bouncy, clean, and moisturized.
Many customers highlight the plastic-free, eco-friendly, and sustainable nature of the bar as a key reason they bought it.
Several reviewers note the bars last a long time and are worth the price.
Some reviewers find the fragrance too strong or overwhelming.
A few reviewers mention the product can be drying if too much is used or wears out faster than the conditioner.
